description: A copy into a folder an NTFS disk holds, recorded, beside which a user made a folder of the same key directly since the last walk: the look before the copy lists each folder on the way, finds the user's beside the copy's, and refuses the copy, name-refused, with nothing journaled or written (conformance/models/README.md, flaw 24).
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "01D9F3A2B4C5E6F7"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ntfs"

steps.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ops), (SELECT count(*) FROM jobs), (SELECT count(*) FROM copies c JOIN files f ON f.id = c.file_id WHERE c.disk_id = 't2' AND f.lpath = CAST('Films/a' AS BLOB))
